options.content: Raw device diagnostics, not period energy or billing meters. Hybrid inverter AC output includes possible battery output and is not pure PV production. Grid meter location must be the unique validated interconnection; never add duplicate meter counters. Battery current is **positive charging**, opposite powerflow P_Akku. Capacity API units are unverified; no Ah/kWh inference. Optional AC day/year counters may be unavailable. Neutral colors are not manufacturer limits.

panels.title: Eigenverbrauch (momentan, Gerät)

panels.title: Momentane Gerätequoten - Verlauf
panels.description: Device-reported; fresh field/endpoint and contract-v2 metadata required. No manufacturer-specific normal limits. Keine energiegewichteten Periodenquoten. Nicht als Tages-/Monatsautarkie oder direkter Eigenverbrauch verwenden.

panels.description: time() minus last non-empty endpoint receipt. This does not establish every field’s presence or sensor-internal freshness. Gaps are not zero. Compare to configured thresholds; missing exporter samples are unavailable.

panels.title: Field presence · last processed collection
panels.description: 1 present, 0 omitted/invalid in last processed result; absent metadata is unknown. Presence alone is not freshness. Collection receipt ages and source-specific thresholds are shown separately.
